notes: The Architect and Engineer of California, the 50 Internet Archive items from September 1905 to December 1920 (usmodernist-AECA-*). Placement needed the roll year plus one more check — lot area, offset, storey count, a Planning building name, or the page already crediting the same architect from another source. Numbered addresses were the previous batch (aeca-1905-1959-numbered).
